description: Header file defining the split6_flexible_o_du_low_session_factory class, which creates and manages sessions for a flexible O-DU low component in a 5G network, including start time calculation and session creation methods.

classes.name: split6_flexible_o_du_low_session_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing split6 flexible O-DU low sessions, including start time calculation.

classes.name: start_time_calculator
classes.description: Nested class responsible for calculating the start time of a session based on jitter and window size.

methods.name: calculate_start_time
methods.description: Calculates the start time for a session based on jitter and window size, returning an optional time point.

methods.name: create_o_du_low_session
methods.description: Creates a new split6_flexible_o_du_low_session object based on the provided cell configuration.

methods.name: create_radio_unit
methods.description: Creates a radio unit for the session with given dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: create_o_du_low
methods.description: Creates an O-DU low component with specified configuration and dependencies.
